method: Exact 7557-token chat-template input from a real Codex Responses request; prompt and token IDs omitted.

Cold is first asynchronous request after factory loading; warm runs reuse allocations and weight preparation.
History cleared before each run; all runs missed 7557 tokens and hit zero cached tokens.
One target output token isolates prefill; this does not measure sustained draft decoding.
Temporary LD_PRELOAD NVTX shim marks existing exported functions; no extra CUDA synchronization.
CUDA runtime correlation IDs associate device work with its innermost host NVTX range.
GPU active time is union of kernel, memcpy and memset intervals, not sum of overlapping events.
Host selection gap runs from return of score D2H API to entry of index H2D API.
MoE host range includes queued attention completion and concurrent CPU/GPU expert work; inclusive ranges must not be added.
Single measurement per condition; no CPU perf samples (perf_event_open unavailable).
